page.title: Zwiṱumani
page.intro: Kha vha ṱume akhaunthu dzavho dza u ḓivhadza. Vharangaphanḓa vha bvaho kha khungedzelo dzaṋu vha swika kha Vharangaphanḓa vhanga nga vhuḓiitisi, na u shumisa na mutengo nga murangaphanḓa.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form i livhisa kha Vharangaphanḓa Vhanga, u shumisa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe na mutengo nga murangaphanḓa, na vhuimo ha vharangaphanḓa vhu rumelwaho murahu kha LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: A i athu setha kha seva iyi

banner.connected: LinkedIn yo ṱangana. Vharangaphanḓa vha khou dzhiiwa zwino - siaṱari iḽi ḽi ḓo khwiniswa nga tshifhinganyana.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn a i athu vhewa kha seva iyi. Mulanguli u tea u engedza ID ya khasiṱama ya app ya LinkedIn na tshiphiri.
banner.expired: Vhuṱumani ha LinkedIn ho fhela, ngauralo vharangaphanḓa a vha khou ṱanganya. Dovhani ni ṱanganedze u itela u bvela phanḓa.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn i ṱoḓa uri ni dzhene hafhu nga {{date}} . U dovha wa ṱanganya phanḓa ha zwenezwo u itela uri dzi lead dzi dzule dzi tshi khou elela.

connect.title: Kha vha ṱume LinkedIn
connect.intro: Dzhenani nga akhaunthu LinkedIn ine ya langa khungedzelo dzaṋu. Leadrat i vhala fhedzi akhaunthu dzaṋu dza khungedzelo, Lead Gen Form leads na zwitatamennde zwa khungedzelo, na u rumela tshanduko dzine na dzi vula.
connect.need1: Mushumo kha akhaunthu ya khungedzelo LinkedIn (Muṱaleli kana nṱha).
connect.need2: Mushumo kha siaṱari ḽa khamphani ḽo ṱumanaho (Mulanguli, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Muṱhogomeli kana Muṱoḓisisi) - LinkedIn i ṱoḓa uri i kovhekane vharangaphanḓa.
connect.need3: Mbudziso ya nomboro ya luṱingo kha Lead Gen Forms dzaṋu - vharangaphanḓa vha si na nomboro ya luṱingo a vha nga engedzwi.

connection.title: Vhuṱumani
connection.autoRenews: U swikelela zwi a vusuludzwa nga zwone zwiṋe u swika nga tshenetsho tshifhinga
connection.noAutoRenew: Tswikelelo a i vusuludziwi nga vhuḓiitisi
connection.syncResult: Sync yo itwa: {{received}} yo ṱanganedzwa, {{created}} yo sikwa, {{duplicates}} dovholola, {{rejected}} yo hanedzwa.
connection.refreshAccounts: Kha vha vusuludze akhaunthu dza khungedzelo
connection.confirmDisconnect: U bvisa LinkedIn ? U ṱanganya zwi a ima nahone zwiga zwa u swikelela zwi a phumulwa. Vharangaphanḓa, zwitatisitiki na ḽogo ya mushumo zwi a vhulungwa.
connection.noPermission: Ni nga vhona siaṱari iḽi. U ṱumanya na u shandukisa zwishumiswa zwi ṱoḓa thendelo ya "Langula zwishumiswa".
connection.fetchTitle: Kha vha wane vharangaphanḓa nga vhukati ha maḓuvha
connection.fetchHint: Leads ntswa dzi ya sedziwa nga murahu ha miniti dzi si gathi na maduvha a 7 o fhelaho aya dovha a sedziwa duvha linwe na linwe, ngauralo ahuna tshine tsha vha uri tsho xela. Shumisani hezwi kha vhane vha khou ni ṱoḓa u bva musi ni sa athu ṱangana, kana u sedza tshifhinga hafhu (u swika kha maḓuvha a 90 nga tshifhinga). Leads dzine dza vha hone kale kha Leadrat dzi a skip.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} yo wanala, {{created}} yo sikwa, {{duplicates}} yo dovhololwaho, {{rejected}} yo hanedzwaho, {{skipped}} yo no ḓi ḓiswa.

accounts.title: Akhaunthu dza khungedzelo
accounts.intro: Vharangaphanḓa na zwitatisitiki zwi ṱanganedzwa u bva kha akhaunthu dza khungedzelo dzo vuleaho hafha.
accounts.none: A hu na akhaunthu dza khungedzelo dzo wanalaho dza akhaunthu iyi LinkedIn . Sedzani mushumo wa akhaunthu kha Campaign Manager LinkedIn , nga murahu ni vusuludze.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Vhudzani LinkedIn uri ndi ifhio kha vharangaphanḓa vhayo ye ya vha zwilavhelelwa zwa vhukuma. Musi murangaphanḓa LinkedIn a tshi swika kha vhuimo vhune na vhu nanga afho fhasi, Leadrat i zwi vhiga kha LinkedIn , ngauralo mivhigo yaṋu ya fulo i sumbedza vhuimo ha murangaphanḓa nahone LinkedIn i nga wana vhathu vhanzhi vha takadzaho vharangaphanḓa vhaṋu vha khwine. ID ya vharangaphanḓa vha LinkedIn fhedzi na hash ya nḓila nthihi ya imeiḽi zwine zwa rumelwa.
capi.noRules: A hu athu vha na zwiimo zwo vhewaho.
capi.created: U shandukiswa ho sikiwa kha LinkedIn na u vhewa kha mepe.
